'''Lucky''' was the name of a [[Rancor/Legends|Rancor]] living in the [[Coronet Zoo]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]] the [[Zoo/Legends|zoo]] security was damaged and Lucky was among many wild creatures that escaped into the streets of [[Axial Park]]. Lucky was at some point infected by the madness from one of the [[Seeds of Rage]], but before he could do any lasting damage he was killed by a group of individuals fighting in the area.<ref name="SWTOR" /> Lucky was known to harbor [[Parasite/Legends|parasitic]] [[clingmoss]]es.<ref name="Belsavis">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|[World Boss] Special Request: Belsavis|Belsavis}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Lucky appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a World Boss on Corellia.
